verdict.rationale: Speechmatics has a dedicated languages documentation page (docs.speechmatics.com/speech-to-text/languages.md). The cited snippets from it mention Language Identification and an Arabic–English bilingual option. The pricing page claims coverage of "56 languages", and the realtime API references language-based domain-specialized models (finance/medical), which hints at per-model variation. However, none of the cited snippets shows the concrete language list itself or a per-feature or per-model availability matrix, so the depth of the published list is unproven. Missing for 10: the actual enumerated language list in evidence, explicit per-model/per-feature differences (e.g., realtime vs batch, translation, diarization, medical model coverage), independent corroboration.
